derivation: of Hebrew origin (H08256) in imitation of G4809 (συκομωραία);

occurrences.text: And the Lord said, If ye had faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye might say unto this sycamine tree, Be thou plucked up by the root, and be thou planted in the sea; and it should obey you.
